senses.gloss:
m. (-तिः)
A monarch of India, the fifth of the lunar race.

m. (-यी)
1 A road.
2 A name of ŚIVA.
E.
या to go, Uṇādi aff. ई, and the root repeated, form irr.

m. (-युः)
1 A horse fit for the Aśvamedha sacrifice.
2 Any horse.
E.
या to go, Uṇādi aff. उ, the root reiterated, and form irr.

m. (-कः)
The performer of frequent sacrifices.
E.
यज to sacrifice, aff. ऊक, the root repeated, and the first vowel made long.

mfn. (-रः-रा-रं)
1 Going repeatedly.
2 Wandering, vagrant.
m. (-रः)
1 A horse fit for the Aśvamedha sacrifice.
2 The saint JARATKĀRU.
3 A Brahman who has preserved his household fire.
4 A vagrant mendicant.
E.
या to go, in the reiterative form, and वरच् aff.

mfn. (-यी-यिनी-यि)
Going, who or what goes.
E.
या to go, णिनि aff., युक् inserted.
